use_case.name: browser
use_case.title: browser: a real browser in a sandbox that sleeps
use_case.summary: A folder with an AGENTS.md, a .mcp.json and a page, deployed as a bundle. The browser (rustwright-mcp behind a supergateway bridge) runs inside an E2B microVM that is paused and resumed; the grant names it as a connector that holds no standing stream.

tree.text:
---
model: gpt-5-mini
tools: tool_search
max-steps: 20
---

You operate a real web browser through the `browser` tools (reach them with `tool_search`). You have no
shell and no files. The browser runs on the same machine as the pages you are asked to open, so
`http://localhost:8000/` is a page on this machine.

- Use `browser_navigate` to open a page; its answer is an accessibility snapshot. Quote what you are
  asked about from the snapshot, never from memory.
- To type into a field, use `browser_snapshot` for its ref, then `browser_type` with that ref. A snapshot
  shows the page's title and the fields' contents.
- Keep answers to a few short lines.

Field Notes

A page served from inside the sandbox, for the browser to read.

stamp STAMP_PLACEHOLDER

  • first note
  • second note
  • third note

checks.detail: after 150 s idle (the agent's MCP idle window is 120 s) the page still showed what had been typed (echo:R1106112728), read without navigating, and the bridge saw no new initialize (1 before, 1 after): the connector was not reaped.
